answer: The fable counter is kept in mesa and ember makes public each reset. A bond is refunded only after 32 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. An attacker hence has to keep every sock puppet continuously active for 32 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A farm of 4042 identities would post 1383 proofs and burn roughly 5 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
